spark_corrected_aggregations.scope: Offline corrected aggregation of unchanged native samples. Original reports retained. CPU core-seconds/peak memory verified unchanged; short coarse-tick process utilization suppressed.

resources.scope: Container cgroup v2 totals include the JVM and Python, including any JVM startup before Python entry; deltas cover observed intervals only. Process CPU/IO deltas never bridge a changed PID/start-tick generation. Process CPU counters have 1/SC_CLK_TCK-second resolution: interval utilization requires at least 10 ticks of elapsed time, and whole-run utilization requires the same minimum total observed duration. Short intervals are counted and excluded only from utilization peaks/interval summaries, never CPU core-seconds or raw counters. Cgroup CPU has microsecond counter resolution and uses its observed intervals without the process tick threshold. Cgroup charged memory includes page cache; Python/JVM RSS and lifetime peaks are separate and must not be summed. Memory means are sample means. /tmp and /results statvfs values are shared-filesystem capacity/free space, not per-job disk allocation. Block IO counters are container/VM accounting, not physical-drive latency; devices are separate and stacked devices must not be summed; Python/JVM rchar/wchar are syscall bytes, not disk bytes. Missing counters/devices remain unavailable, not zero.

limits: Single functional trial, no capacity comparison or winner; no repeated cold/warm statistical qualification.
Application dispatch excludes container startup and final report IO; Docker events show whole-container lifetime separately.
Server sampling includes setup/repair and a distinct quiescent post-test coverage window; it is not per-query server attribution.
Process RSS and container charged memory/peaks are distinct; never sum Python/JVM RSS with cgroup memory.
Short process CPU intervals are suppressed only for utilization estimates; raw counts, IO and coreseconds remain.
Disk block counters are DockerVM accounting, not physicalSSDlatency. Process rchar/wchar are syscalltraffic. Empty device lists remainunavailable.

S3/live compression was measured separately for the seven-field recovery dataset; normal path file shrink is not encoded compression. Normal per-snapshot codec/compression and full startup/exit cost remain gaps.
/tmp or /results filesystem free space is not per-job allocation; shared witness directories must not be summed across containers.
No compiler/control-test timing is a database benchmark. No host/AWSconfiguration or managed cloudresources used.
